changes: Range playback now validates Content-Range coordinates, byte length, and known total size before serving data.
Upstream 401/403/404/416, ignored Range, invalid 206, HTML login/interstitial pages, and JSON errors produce distinct diagnostics.
HLS diagnostics inspect response data to distinguish common HTTP failures, HTML, and JSON bodies.
External-player feedback reports process startup and asks users to confirm playback in that player; it no longer claims successful decoding.
Playback acceptance argument parsing is isolated from Electron imports so its contract can run independently.
